newsitem.title: ITALY: Henkel cleared buy Loctite Italia.
newsitem.headline: Henkel cleared buy Loctite Italia.

text.p: Italy's anti-trust authority cleared German consumer products and chemicals group Henkel KGaA on Friday to buy the Italian unit of U.S. adhesive maker Loctite Corp.
In a statement, the authority said it had accepted proposals by Henkel to acquire Loctite Italia after the German group bought out the U.S. company earlier this year.
The statement said Henkel had agreed to drop the distribution of adhesive brand Vinavil and dispose of Loctite's Usavinil brand.
It would also cede licences for Bostik brand non-professional adhesives and industrial brands Sicomet and Omnifit as well as cease sales of the anaerobic adhesive Nexus, the statement said.
